
# AOP-Wiki RDF Dashboard

<!--- This file is autogenerated. Edit aopwiki_rdf_dashboard.json to make changes in this page. ---> 

A web dashboard for monitoring and analysing the AOP-Wiki RDF knowledge base over time, with entity counts, Key Event component distributions, ontology usage, AOP completeness, network density, and author contributions, plus CSV download of every plot's underlying data.

![AOP-Wiki RDF Dashboard logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VHP4Safety/cloud/main/docs/service/aopwiki_rdf_dashboard.png)

**Main Webpage:** [https://aopwiki-dashboard.vhp4safety.nl/](https://aopwiki-dashboard.vhp4safety.nl/)

**Tool Webpage:** [https://aopwiki-dashboard.vhp4safety.nl/](https://aopwiki-dashboard.vhp4safety.nl/)
